_readme: Slots for your own artwork and audio. Put artwork into src/assets/art/ and sound into src/assets/audio/, using the 'file' name listed for each slot, and it appears on the site by itself (the site finds the files when it is built). Until then: while developing, a labelled frame shows which file to add; on the live site a plain stand-in is shown. The Sound button only appears once at least one sound file exists, and sound stays off until the agent switches it on.
